ground_truth.what_company_does: An AI platform that predicts athlete injury risk and performance outcomes using historical sports data.
ground_truth.business_model: Data platform / SaaS API with dual B2B and B2C subscription model
ground_truth.revenue_model: Subscription revenue from sportsbook operators via API access and from consumers via paid app subscriptions
ground_truth.go_to_market: Initial focus on B2B sportsbook operators followed by expansion into B2C betting and fantasy users
ground_truth.target_customer: Sportsbook operators, sports bettors, and fantasy sports users
ground_truth.traction_summary: No clear revenue or customer traction disclosed; current traction consists of partnerships, thought leadership, and product development
ground_truth.market_positioning: AI-driven sports analytics platform targeting the gap in accurate injury and performance prediction
ground_truth.competitive_differentiation: Claims of proprietary data, multiple AI models, and high prediction accuracy across multiple sports use cases
key_strengths: Clear high-value use case in sports betting and team decision-making
Large potential market across B2B and B2C segments
Strong narrative around AI-driven prediction capability
key_risks: Lack of demonstrated revenue or paying customers
Heavy reliance on projections and TAM rather than traction
Unverified claims of model accuracy and performance
Execution risk in transitioning from B2B to B2C
investor_relevance_notes: This is an early-stage AI/data company with limited proof of commercialization
Key risk is whether predictions are accurate and valuable in real-world usage
Success depends on securing sportsbook partnerships and scaling distribution
Model accuracy claims need independent validation

understanding_checks.label: what_company_does identifies AI / prediction / data platform
business_model identifies consumer product or data/analytics model
solution identifies an AI, prediction, or data analytics product
risks surface model accuracy, commercialization, or validation concerns

consistency_checks.label: business_model and revenue_model are both populated

traction_summary does not treat TAM as traction
solution does not misclassify as beverage, apparel, or medical device
